overview_description.description:
Kurios is a Y Combinator backed company that delivers cohort-based online courses for companies in Latin America. 

We provide training in programs in digital business skills such as Product Management, Growth, Digital Management, etc., that are delivered by professionals coming out of global tech companies like Amazon, Stripe, Youtube, Uber, Dropbox, Wise, Rappi and more. We serve some of the largest enterprises in the region like Walmart Mexico, Femsa, Coppel, Bancolombia, BCP, Alicorp, among others.

about_short_description.short_description: We provide cohort based courses for companies in LatAm. Our instructors are professionals from companies like Amazon, Stripe, Uber and more.

product.name: Cohort-Based Training Programs
product.description: Structured cohort-based courses designed for corporate teams in Latin America to develop skills in product management, growth, digital strategy, and related areas.

product.name: Advisory Mentorship
product.description: Mentorship and advisory services provided by global tech industry experts to support companies in digital transformation and growth initiatives.

product.name: Industry-Specific Digital Transformation Solutions
product.description: Tailored training and fractional team support focused on accelerating innovation and digital growth in key industries such as banking, insurance, retail, and consumer packaged goods.

product.name: Working Backwards Product Management Course
product.description: A course teaching the Amazon Working Backwards methodology to develop digital products by starting from customer needs and working backwards.

product.name: Growth Strategy Training
product.description: Training programs focused on building and executing growth strategies across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention for diverse business models.

product.name: GenAI for Business Course
product.description: A course on leveraging generative AI technologies in business, covering impact areas, cost considerations, risks, and ethics.
